note: Halloween takes the city: pumpkin blaze, zoo boo and harvest festivals across the boroughs

picks.reason: The Great Jack O'Lantern Blaze — thousands of carved pumpkins lit up at Van Cortlandt Manor, the region's signature Halloween night
Boo at the Zoo returns to the Bronx Zoo with costumes and treat stations, included with admission
Free Boo Bash in the Bronx at St. James Park — costumes, candy and family entertainment
Spooktober! at Prospect Park Zoo — a low-cost Halloween outing for the littlest ones
Free Indigenous Peoples' Day celebration with NAIC-NY on the Bronx Zoo's river walk
Fall Festival at Lakeside in Prospect Park — hayrides, crafts and harvest fun on Sunday
Free Sunday Smorgasburg in Prospect Park — the city's biggest open-air food market
The Very Hungry Caterpillar Show off-Broadway at DR2 — puppetry magic for the preschool set
